title: instanceof against an ancestor of the declared parameter type is always true

ground_truth.statement: Exception is in RuntimeException's parent chain and instanceof walks the chain, so `$e instanceof \Exception` is true for every value the parameter can hold and the expression cannot distinguish any two inputs.

notes: Legacy pattern: a parameter typed with the subclass that the body re-checks against the parent class. PHPStan reports it; Psalm and Mago 1.57.0 are silent, although both have a redundant/impossible condition rule that fires for other always-true checks (see cases narrowing/is-numeric-after-is-int and narrowing/object-is-always-truthy for Mago and Psalm).
